title.value: Application of Artificial Intelligence in Shared Decision Making: Scoping Review
title.justification: The paper focuses on the application of artificial intelligence in the context of shared decision making, which aligns with the central theme of the title.
title.quote: Application of Artificial Intelligence in Shared Decision Making: Scoping Review.

extractions.description: This paper is a scoping review that investigates how artificial intelligence (AI) is used in shared decision making within healthcare contexts. The paper maps out the existing uses of AI to facilitate shared decision-making processes between healthcare providers and patients, highlights the current state of research in this area, and identifies future research needs.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on the use of AI in healthcare shared decision making, which does not directly contribute to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Objective: We aimed to identify and evaluate published studies that have tested or implemented AI to facilitate SDM.

primary_category.justification: The central theme is the application of AI in healthcare shared decision making, which is not directly related to any Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development category.
primary_category.quote: We conducted a scoping review as a first step toward a comprehensive overview of the literature on the use of AI in SDM.

secondary_categories.justification: There is no discussion or implicit indication of any relation to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development even in a secondary context.
secondary_categories.quote: The objective of the scoping review is to examine evidence on the use of AI in SDM, namely, to explore what has already been done and what future roles may exist for the use of AI in SDM.

primary_sub_category.justification: No sub-category aligns with the theme of AI in healthcare decision-making mechanisms.
primary_sub_category.quote: AI has shown promising results in various fields of medicine. It has the potential to facilitate shared decision making (SDM).

secondary_sub_categories.justification: This review does not pertain to any secondary sub-categories related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: AI interventions can open up more time for health care providers to spend connecting with their patients.

applications.value: AI in healthcare shared decision making
applications.justification: The paper's core discussion revolves around mapping the use of AI in SDM within healthcare contexts.
applications.quote: All used AI to support SDM by providing clinical recommendations or predictions.

new_primary_category.justification: The content primarily revolves around healthcare and AI technologies to support decision-making, necessitating a category that reflects this.
new_primary_category.quote: We observed a lack of emphasis on patients’ values and preferences, as well as poor reporting of AI interventions, resulting in a lack of clarity about different aspects.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The focus on AI applications in SDM within healthcare highlights a need for more specific categorization under an existing healthcare framework.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: We aimed to systematically examine the evidence on the use of AI in SDM through a scoping review to map existing knowledge.
